// diagnostic

E2473

Query key `{key}` already uses footprint `{registered}`; requested `{requested}`

What

Query key `{key}` already uses footprint `{registered}`; requested `{requested}`

Why

An explicit key is the sole cache identity. Registering it with a second footprint would make invalidation ambiguous and split one logical query into multiple cache entries.

Fix

Use the existing footprint for `{key}`, or choose a new key for the new dependency declaration.
